newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat futures end little changed.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat futures end little changed.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed narrowly mixed, with May posting the greatest change ending down 2-1/4 cents at $4.16-1/4 per bushel.
Traders said the spring wheat futures appeared to be following the direction of CBOT soybeans during the session, going lower early and then recovering late.

Cargill Investor Services bought about two million bushels of May, 200,000 of July and 500,000 of September, which traders said appeared to be short covering. Selling was spread among several firms but LFG was noted selling 1.1 million of July.
Forecasts for cold and snow in spring wheat areas lent light support to July and September, but traders said much of that support had been priced into the futures during previous sessions.
MGE spring wheat futures closed down 2-1/4 to up 1/2 with May off the most. July closed unchanged at $4.07-3/4 a bushel, but peaked during the session at $4.11.
Estimated volume was 21.846 million bushels, with May the leader at 12.092 million.
